subject: dsa
title: Find Pivot Index
summary: Scan once, keeping a running left sum. The right sum is the total minus the left sum minus the current value; the pivot is where the two sides match.
problem: Find the index where the sum of all values to its left equals the sum of all values to its right.

steps.caption: Find the index where everything to its left sums to the same as everything to its right.
The whole array sums to 28. As we scan, we split it into a left sum and a right sum.
Index 0: left sum 0, right sum 27. Not equal.
Index 3: left 11 (1+7+3) equals right 11 (5+6). Pivot found!
